1016499.name: Botanic Primary School Nursery Unit
1016499.rules: Within the applicable target-age priority category, the school considered first preference, then a sibling currently attending, then straight-line postcode distance. Age broke a remaining distance tie.

1110002.name: McArthur Nursery School
1110002.rules: Within the applicable target-age category, the school gave priority to siblings of current or former pupils, other children living permanently at the same address, or a first or only child. It then considered straight-line distance to the nursery.
